## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `20a1c07d427705a43f6b683cf03366411f4f405a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md + none

Inputs read: card #31621 (body and all 3 comments: triage 6724973471, claim 6725665698, dev report 6725775429), PR #31648 (body, file list, net diff: one file, +4/-2), the check-runs on `20a1c07d`, and contract review 6724527824 on PR #31616, the source of this card. The tree was read with `git show` at the head and at `origin/main` `c5361e2c`; no commit between the merge base `99364ea7` and `c5361e2c` touches `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` or `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/`, so the dev's `99364ea7` measurement and this one read the same files. The local clone is shallow (grafted history), so dates below come from the ADR's own amendment text and the GitHub merge timestamps of the PRs it names, not from `git log`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Face: `docs/adr/**` is a governed register row, so the rules face and `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; `reviewFace` hits = `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` alone. Right.
- No implementing file in the diff: the ADR's own "No automatic check" paragraph (L386-390 at head) makes a reviewer of `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` the sentence's first consumer, and no gate enforces the object count. `+ none` is right.
- Net diff: the head is one commit over the merge base `99364ea7`, one file, one hunk (L317-321), +4/-2. No `ai` block, no bucket list, no package file moves. No accept-set change, no public-surface change. Right.
- The count of twelve as of 2026-10-30: the H/C/E lists at head name 61 actions on exactly 13 object prefixes (`sys_account`, `sys_api_key`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member`, `sys_oauth_application`, `sys_organization`, `sys_scim_connection_credential`, `sys_session`, `sys_sso_provider`, `sys_team`, `sys_team_member`, `sys_two_factor`, `sys_user`). The census paragraph (L374-379) says the 2026-10-30 assessment covered 58 actions and names the three later additions: `sys_invitation.copy_invitation_link` (2026-10-31) and the two `sys_scim_connection_credential` actions (2026-11-07); 61 - 3 = 58, and those 58 span the 12 non-SCIM prefixes (`sys_invitation` keeps 5 others). So each of the twelve carried a named action at the 2026-10-30 assessment. True.
- The thirteenth is `sys_scim_connection_credential`: on `origin/main` exactly 13 `*.object.ts` under `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` declare an `actions:` array (34 object files read, 21 with none; no other `actions` spelling), and the 13 are the 13 prefixes above. `sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts` L69 `actions: [` holds `mint_scim_credential` (L87, no `ai` key) and `revoke_scim_credential` (L149, `ai: { exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true }` L174-178), matching the H and C placements the 2026-11-07 amendment records. PR #31119 (`a794e32c9b`), which the amendment names as shipping those actions, merged 2026-11-07T14:04Z, after 2026-10-30. True.
- "Assessed once, as one set" still holds: the rewritten sentence binds that clause to "the twelve ... at the 2026-10-30 assessment", which is the one set the 2026-10-30 ruling assessed; the SCIM pair sits after the semicolon as the 2026-11-07 amendment's own assessment, and the two 2026-10-31 moves are moves, not a second set. Had the sentence said "thirteen ... assessed once, as one set" (the card's route B), the clause would be false. Right.
- The edit adds no new assessment: no name enters or leaves any of the H/C/E lists, the counts "H 24 / C 18 / E 19" and "37 `ai` blocks" are unchanged, and `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (`sys-user.object.ts`, no `ai` key) and `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` (`sys-sso-provider.object.ts`, no `ai` key) are untouched in the diff and in the tree, still human-only until a ruling. Right.
- Gate verdicts are the head's check-runs, not the body's "21/21": 45 check-runs on `20a1c07d`, 44 completed and every one of those `success` or `skipped` (`Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards` all `success`); `Test Core (1/8)` was `in_progress` on the last read, and the diff touches no file it tests. Right.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only; no released package moves; `skip-changeset` label present and no `.changeset/` file in the diff, which matches AGENTS.md §3 ("that label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package"). Right.
Clause-②: `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial in the PR body, agree with the diff (no key, value or meaning an author can write changes). No changeset body exists to carry a second copy, which is what `skip-changeset` means. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open draft PR #31616 (card #31452, head `2b0213ee`, contract review 6724527824 PASS) edits the same file. Both diffs are cut from the same base blob (`fd0d46a0f5e`); #31616's hunk is L372-383 (the census sentence "one more identity action" to "two more", and the "Not assessed" paragraph naming `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options`), this PR's hunk is L317-321. The hunks are disjoint and 50 lines apart, so a three-way merge of whichever lands second is textually clean, and the two edits agree semantically: this sentence's "a thirteenth" and #31616's "two more identity actions, unassessed" describe the same tree. On this head alone, L374-375 still reads "the tree holds one more identity action, unassessed" and L382-384 names one; that is #31616's hunk, not this card's, and stays stale here until #31616 lands. Serial order is the seat's (claim 6725665698: this card lands after #31616, the dev merges `origin/main` once it does). No conflict to resolve on this head.
- Dev report `open_questions[0]` ("which spelling"): route A (historical twelve dated to 2026-10-30, thirteenth named) is the one that keeps "assessed once, as one set" true, as judged in ①; route B would break it and route C would leave the present count unsaid. The card's "pick by reading the paragraph whole" is met. Answered; no maintainer input needed.
- Dev deviation "PR opened with no assignee": landing is Tier H, the maintainer's hand or a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` review; this record does not lift it and is not an approval. Nothing for this record to do.
- Dev deviation "`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exit 3, then built `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` to run it": a dev-side gate run, not a tree change; the head's `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are `success`. Accepted.
- Card "Not in scope": assessing `sys_user.list_platform_admins` or `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` is a maintainer ruling. The diff does not assess either (①). Held.

### ④ Design judgment

**`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`** — judged against its first consumer (a reviewer of `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` reading the addendum) and the tree it describes.

The rewritten sentence, clause by clause:
- "The named actions on the twelve identity objects that carried them in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` at the 2026-10-30 assessment" — true: 12 prefixes carry the 58 actions of the 2026-10-30 assessment (①). "Them" resolves to "the named actions"; the relative clause reads once, not twice.
- "were assessed once, as one set, into three buckets, and the declarations were written in the same change as this addendum" — now scoped to the twelve, which is the set the 2026-10-30 ruling assessed and declared in one change; the SCIM declarations came in PR #31119 and are not claimed by this clause. True.
- "the 2026-11-07 amendment below brought in a thirteenth, `sys_scim_connection_credential`" — the amendment blockquote is at L334-342, below the sentence; it names the object's two actions; the census paragraph (L378-379) dates them to the same amendment; the tree has the object as the 13th action-bearer. True and consistent with the rest of the addendum.

Attempts to break it: (a) could an identity object have gained its first action between 2026-10-30 and today other than SCIM, making the "twelve" a different twelve? No: the two post-assessment unassessed actions sit on `sys_user` and `sys_sso_provider`, both already among the twelve with assessed actions. (b) Could a 13th action-bearing object be missing from the H/C/E lists? No: the 13 prefixes in the lists are exactly the 13 files with an `actions:` array on `origin/main`. (c) Does the word "below" fail if the amendment is read in isolation? No: the only 2026-11-07 amendment in the ADR is the blockquote at L334, 13 lines under the sentence. (d) Does the edit alter any rule? No: the opening blockquote (L310-314) still says the addendum changes no rule, and the three bucket rows are untouched.

Findings:
- nit (outside this PR's hunk, owned by open PR #31616): the census paragraph at L374-375 and the "Not assessed" paragraph at L382-384 on this head still count one unassessed identity action where the tree holds two. Not introduced by this PR, no effect on this hunk's truth or on the contract; #31616 is the fix and is already reviewed PASS. Flagged in ③ for landing order; no action on this head.

No must-fix. No should-fix. No finding on the hunk itself.
